feeding_claim.verbatim: Our cows and lamb are 100% grass fed and finished. They are not given grain ever.

local_areas: Door delivery to some zip codes in Michiana

notes: Family farm of about 300 acres at Walkerton in northern Indiana, run by Matt and Beth Laidig since 2014. The GrazeCart store also runs at thirddayfarmllc.com. Read the homepage, about page, farming practices page, 100% grass-fed beef page, how it works, contact, the winter beef sale page and location pages for the farm store, Fort Wayne, Westfield, Warsaw, River Valley Church and Rocky River Tap & Table. Beef and lamb are grass-fed and finished with no grain; pigs are raised in the woods and poultry in mobile coops on GMO-free feed, so pork, poultry and eggs are pastured, not grass-finished. Chicks come from a Michigan hatchery; cattle, lambs and piglets are born on the farm. Bulk beef is sold as 1/2, 1/4 and 1/8 bundles.
